cases.brief: 按照这个内容来做PPT：《Hi Calder, Thanks a lot for the detailed investigation and for flagging this — this is very helpful. Could you please share the full request/response payloads and the corresponding timestamps for a few of the failed calls?... Best, Kate》
Create a 10-slide presentation explaining the key principles of effective team communication for new managers.
Build a deck on the current state of the humanoid robotics industry in 2026, including the leading companies, recent funding rounds, major product launches, and market outlook.
Make a presentation about Apple’s latest product launches and explain how they compare with Samsung’s current flagship devices.
Turn the following notes into a clean investor update deck. Revenue grew 18% QoQ, churn improved from 4.2% to 3.5%, enterprise pipeline is $8.4M, and the new onboarding flow launches next month.
Nike brand history — make it visual and engaging.
做一份关于生成式 AI 是怎么工作的 PPT，面向完全不懂技术的人，多用图示，少用文字。
Put together a deck on why GLP-1 drugs are reshaping the obesity treatment market. Use the most recent market data, major players, sales figures, and regulatory developments.
Japan trip presentation. Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, food, temples, cherry blossoms, cool places. Make it beautiful.

We need a deck for tomorrow’s leadership meeting about our pricing strategy. Something around value-based pricing, packaging, discount discipline, and how sales should communicate price increases. Not sure exactly how to structure it.

Create a board meeting deck based on the following internal updates: Q2 revenue was $12.4M, gross margin improved to 68%, enterprise sales were below plan, we hired a new VP of Sales, and the product team is delaying the analytics launch by six weeks. Please highlight the key risks and decisions needed.

按照以下内容做一份董事会 PPT。Page 1 是封面图，主题为「螣龙安科 2026 H1 董事会」。后续页面包括：H1 核心经营结论、收入利润和现金情况、Anna 用户及 Hackathon 数据、Anna OS 产品和商业模式、Codex / Claude Code / Genspark / Manus / n8n / Dify / Gamma 等全球同类产品对比、各类 App 商业化测算、2026 H2 增长规划、第二届全球 Hackathon、关键里程碑和融资计划。具体数据、表格和页面内容如下：〔后附完整 page 1–11 内容〕
2026 AI agents landscape. 8 slides. Make it VC-style.
Create a visually stunning presentation about cybersecurity. Dark theme, hackers, networks, glowing code, futuristic feel.
Here are our customer interview notes from 25 users. Turn them into a deck showing the top pain points, recurring themes, representative quotes, and product opportunities.
Who are the top 10 AI coding startups right now? Make a deck with funding, founders, traction, and what makes each company different.
Create a presentation on the history of the Coca-Cola bottle, using real photos of how the bottle design changed over time.
Tesla strategy presentation.
Tesla strategy presentation — focus on its current pricing, product lineup, China performance, margins, and competitive pressure in 2026.
帮我把下面的年度战略材料整理成一份董事会 PPT，要高级一点、有科技感，最好每页都有一些视觉表达。材料里包括今年的收入、利润、现金流情况，新 AI 产品的用户数据，几个主要竞争对手的比较，未来半年的商业化目标、海外增长计划和融资安排。请帮我重新组织一下逻辑，让董事会能快速看懂重点。〔后附完整材料〕
Create a deck explaining how SpaceX reusable rockets work. Use simple diagrams for launch, stage separation, landing, and reuse.
Create a deck about SpaceX’s major launches over the past 12 months, including Starship milestones, launch dates, outcomes, and photos from the missions.
I pasted the full earnings release below. Make an analyst-style deck summarizing revenue, margins, guidance, segment performance, and management commentary.
Make me a presentation on OpenAI.

Make me a presentation on OpenAI’s position in the AI market today, including its latest products, major competitors, partnerships, business model, and recent strategic developments. Use product and company visuals where useful.
Turn this 30-page strategy memo into a concise 12-slide board deck. Keep the core argument, simplify the language, and surface the most important decisions.
Create a deck on the global data center boom and show which regions are adding the most capacity in 2026. Include hyperscaler investments and power constraints.
The evolution of iPhone design from 2007 to today. Make it image-heavy and show the actual devices across generations.
Explain the evolution of smartphone design from physical keyboards to full-screen devices. Use clean illustrations and timelines.
Here’s our Q3 pipeline export. Please make a sales review deck by region, rep, stage, average deal size, win probability, and top risks.
Make a 6-slide deck on how subscription businesses should think about CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and payback period.
What are the fastest-growing consumer AI apps this month? Build a deck showing rankings, growth, use cases, and monetization.
做一个关于故宫建筑美学的 PPT，多放真实建筑照片，重点讲中轴线、屋顶、色彩和空间秩序。
做一份关于中国传统建筑空间秩序的教学 PPT，用示意图解释中轴、院落、主次关系。
I’ve pasted three competitor websites and my notes below. Make a comparison deck covering positioning, pricing, target users, strengths, and weaknesses based on this material.
Compare Notion, Coda, Airtable, and ClickUp as they exist today. Include current pricing, AI features, target users, and major product differences.
Make a visual moodboard-style presentation for a luxury hotel brand: quiet, warm, minimal, Japanese-inspired, natural materials, soft lighting.
Make a moodboard for Aman Tokyo using real images of the hotel, rooms, lobby, views, and dining spaces.
Create a presentation from this meeting transcript. Organize it into decisions made, unresolved questions, owners, deadlines, and next steps.
Create a presentation on the biggest cybersecurity incidents of 2026 so far, what happened, who was affected, and the lessons for enterprise security teams.
Make a presentation about the CrowdStrike outage and use screenshots or photos from the actual incident to show its real-world impact.
Explain what an API is in 5 slides for nontechnical executives. Use analogies and diagrams.
Create an investor deck from the following startup description: AI assistant for dentists, $80k MRR, 12% MoM growth, 70 clinics, 91% gross retention, raising $3M. Make it compelling.
We’re raising $3M for an AI assistant for dentists. Build an investor deck and add market size, competitor landscape, industry growth, and recent comparable funding rounds.
Create a deck about Paris fashion week trends.
Create a deck explaining the basic principles of fashion trend forecasting.
Please turn the content below into a polished company introduction deck. It mentions our offices in New York, Singapore, and London, 400 employees, Fortune 500 customers, and a 2026 expansion plan.
Create a company introduction deck for Stripe, including what it offers today, key products, customers, competitors, recent strategic moves, and geographic expansion.
Build a presentation about famous works by Van Gogh. I want each section to show the actual painting being discussed.
Explain Impressionism to high school students: what changed, why it mattered, and how to recognize the style. Use simple visual explanations.
